null_read.source:
interface bus_if;logic clk;logic[7:0] data;modport drive(input clk,output data);modport observe(input clk,data);endinterface
module top;bus_if a();virtual bus_if vif;initial $display("%0d",vif.data);endmodule

null_write.source:
interface bus_if;logic clk;logic[7:0] data;modport drive(input clk,output data);modport observe(input clk,data);endinterface
module top;bus_if a();virtual bus_if vif;initial vif.data=1;endmodule

null_ref.source:
interface bus_if;logic clk;logic[7:0] data;modport drive(input clk,output data);modport observe(input clk,data);endinterface
module top;bus_if a();virtual bus_if vif;task automatic alter(ref logic[7:0] value);value=1;endtask initial alter(vif.data);endmodule
